title: pancashloki — pan-p05
question: Much time dwelling with You has passed — alas, in this very moment! What, what has not been done by You for me, for the sake of serving the excellent guru! Again and again I, whose body has attained the incomparable divine plane — yet indeed I forget You. Therefore, by You, let there be no further staying-away!
